name: ScamShield
tagline: Forward the message. See the mechanics. Know what to do next.
summary: ScamShield by Palimpsest provides evidence-bounded suspicious-message triage for Telegram users, developers, and research workflows.

trust.claim: Pattern evidence for triage, never a finding of guilt or verified illegality.

disambiguation: ScamShield by Palimpsest is the open-source Telegram message-triage system at @Scamshield_2_bot; it is not affiliated with other services named ScamShield.
